examples.arabic: بس صار معهم موقف مضحك مبارح: رئيس البلدية، وهو عم يسقي الزرع ببير بيته، شاف فاتورة الكهرباء تبعيته.
examples.english: But something funny happened to them yesterday: the mayor, while watering the plants with his house's well, saw his electricity bill.
examples.transliteration: Bass sar ma'ahom mawqaf mudhek mbarah: ra'ees el baladiyyah, w huwwa 'am yisqi ez zar' bi beer bayto, shaf fatourat el kahraba tabe'itoh.
examples.storyTitle: The Bill Problem at the Public Garden: News from Karm El Zeitoun

examples.arabic: مكتب المدير صار مطبخ صغير لتحضير الوجبات السخنة لكل الناس كل بعد الظهر.
examples.english: The principal's office has become a small kitchen to prepare hot meals for everyone every afternoon.
examples.transliteration: Maktab el-mudiir saar matbakh sghir la-tahdiir el-wajabat el-sukhne la-kel el-naas kel baad el-duhur.
examples.storyTitle: The Voice of Hope from the Heart of the School

examples.arabic: اكتشف إنه جاره أبو عمر، يلي كان بيفكر إنه صار عدوه بسبب الحرب، كان عم يحمي بيته من الحرامية طول هالسنين.
examples.english: He discovered that his neighbor Abu Omar, whom he thought had become his enemy because of the war, had been protecting his house from thieves all these years.
examples.transliteration: Aktashaf inno jaro Abou Omar, yalli kan bi-fakkir inno sar adouwo bi-sabab al-Harb, kan am yiHmi bayto min al-haramiyya toul hal-sinin.
examples.storyTitle: A Loaf of Hope Amidst the Rubble

examples.arabic: طارق: والله يا لارا، الوضع السياسي عنا بلبنان صار لا يطاق، هيك عم حس حالي ضايع بلا أمل.
examples.english: Tareq: Really, Lara, the political situation here in Lebanon has become unbearable; I feel so lost without hope.
examples.transliteration: Tareq: Wallahi ya Lara, al-wad' al-siyasi 'anna bi-Lubnan sar la yutaq, heik 'am hess hali daye' bila amal.

examples.arabic: النادلة، شابة مبتسمة، سألتها: "شو صار معك؟ حابة تطلبي شي؟"
examples.english: The waitress, a smiling young woman, asked her: 'What happened to you? Do you want to order something?'
examples.transliteration: In-naadile, shabbe mubtasime, sa'aletha: 'Shoo saar ma'ek? Haabbe totlobi shi?'
